answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using verifiable delay functions tied to a continuous river of entropy beacons. Participants maintain identity status by evaluating sequential rounds of an iterative cipher. This forces adversaries to dedicate unparallelizable CPU clock time per identity, preventing single servers from multiplexing virtual clones. However, this overhead penalizes lightweight sparrow agents and fails against adversaries running custom low-latency ASICs.
